input_output: convert_quantity takes Quantity, expected Dimension and output_unit; returns Result<Quantity>. CoordinateFrame origin is mm; each basis column is a local axis in global coordinates.
ScalarTable1D::create takes dimensions and vector<TablePoint>; evaluate requires explicit OutsidePolicy reject or clamp.
implemented_subset.errors_and_effects: Synchronous Result diagnostics reject incompatible/missing units, nonfinite values, invalid frames, unordered tables and rejected extrapolation. No application transaction or cancellation is created by these helpers.
